Trims the trailing slash from the Cerebras base URL before appending `/chat/completions`, so a `CEREBRAS_BASE_URL` ending in `/` no longer produces `/v1//chat/completions`. Adds a local HTTP regression test covering both trailing-slash and no-slash cases. No issues found.
